source.description: A reviewed six-panel built-in image-generation contact sheet showing one consistent leafy vine progressing from pale pencil construction to bold felt-tip outlines and saturated marker color.
source.notes: Keep one face-free diagonal S-curved vine, exactly eight alternating leaves, two curling tendrils, exactly three round berry accents, short leaf veins, two small clusters of three stem-shadow hatch marks, and open paper highlights stable. No flower, pot, border frame, wreath, lettering, face, insect, extra leaf, extra berry, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only flourish.

process_strategy: Lock the diagonal S path, stem width, eight leaf footprints, two tendril curls, and three berry positions in pale construction; establish every leaf, vein, and accent before inking; then color only the visible shapes already present so the finish stays cumulative and handmade.

final_elements.name: diagonal S path, stem width, eight leaf footprints, two tendril routes, and three berry positions
final_elements.description: Pale construction fixes one sweeping vine, exactly eight alternating leaves, two open curls, and three berry accents in one balanced square crop.

final_elements.name: complete double-line vine stem and eight leaf silhouettes
final_elements.description: A tapered double-line stem and eight varied pointed leaves turn the guides into one readable botanical flourish.

final_elements.name: two curling tendrils, three berries, leaf midribs, side veins, and two three-mark stem-shadow hatch clusters
final_elements.description: The two curls, three round accents, simple veins, and short hatches add rhythm without changing the established silhouette.

final_elements.name: thick imperfect black felt-tip outlines and clarified overlaps
final_elements.description: Bold handmade marker reinforces every existing stem, leaf, tendril, berry, vein, and overlap while keeping intentional paper gaps.

final_elements.name: deep-jade and chartreuse leaf fills, raspberry berries, violet stem shadows, and paper highlights
final_elements.description: Saturated limited-color marker fills separate alternating leaves and accents with visible streaks and preserved open-paper shine.

rejection_checks: The same diagonal S path, stem width, eight leaf positions, two tendril curls, three berry positions, crop, and scale must persist through all six panels.
Exactly one vine, eight leaves, two tendrils, and three berries must appear before the final panel and persist.
No flower, pot, wreath, border frame, lettering, face, insect, extra leaf, extra berry, label, arrow, number, fake UI, signature, watermark, or final-only flourish may appear.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip streaks and handmade edge variation rather than clean vector-icon polish, and no adjacent frame may look unchanged at card size.
